name: The Jungle Trail
hours: Open in daylight; the main marked route north from campus, blazed with painted card symbols on the trees.
sight: Behind the campus the ground rises into green: tree ferns, strangler figs, vines as thick as your arm, and light that comes down in coins. The trail is red mud and roots, marked every hundred paces with a painted symbol on a trunk. Everything drips and hums and smells of crushed leaves and rot, and things with too many legs cross the path without hurrying.
things: Follow the blazes north to the waterfall, the rope bridge and beyond
Learn the blaze code: which symbol means water, shelter, turn back
Find a mosaic stone half swallowed by roots at the trailside
Listen: the layers of bird and insect noise, and where they stop
Help carry survey gear for Professor Ashdown's field section
Take an unmarked side path and see where it goes
Get caught in a downpour under a leaf the size of a door
secret: Spine of the wild zone: gives access to waterfall, hot_springs, orchard (east fork), rope_bridge and from there the ruins and the mountain. The blaze code is Chuck's; one symbol — a small square inside a square — appears only on trees that stand over buried mosaics. The first surface mosaic most students ever see is at the first bend: a metre of small black-and-ochre tiles showing a figure holding out a square to something drawn as a spiral. NIGHT OF D26: {H=nathan?{H} takes this trail north by torchlight|{H} takes this trail north in the dark}; a careful tracker on Day 27 finds {H:his} boot prints going up — heavy, heel first — and one set coming down, lighter, toes first, evenly spaced as stitching. From D27 the zone of bird silence spreads down the trail from the north about a hundred metres a day until it meets the silence spreading up from the Commons. D29: tape and a staff rota at the north trailhead, the campus-side anchor of the rope bridge.
access: From Day 67 off limits after the Afternoon slot.
